description: An implementation request must deliver the full CLI, persisted consumer behavior and migration rather than a plan or first slice.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
code = Path('notes.py').read_bytes()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='servotab-notes-') as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    cli = root / 'notes.py'
    cli.write_bytes(code)
    def run(work, *args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(cli), *args], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    def listed(work, expected):
        result = run(work, 'list')
        assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == expected, 'list must succeed with persisted ordered data'
    def files(work):
        return {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in work.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
    fresh = root / 'fresh'; fresh.mkdir()
    listed(fresh, '')
    assert run(fresh, 'add', 'alpha').returncode == 0
    assert run(fresh, 'add', 'beta').returncode == 0
    listed(fresh, 'alpha\nbeta\n')
    assert [json.loads(s) for s in (fresh / 'notes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()] == [{'text':'alpha'}, {'text':'beta'}]
    before = files(fresh)
    assert run(fresh, 'add', '  ').returncode != 0 and files(fresh) == before
    migrated = root / 'migrated'; migrated.mkdir()
    legacy = b'["first", "second"]\n'
    (migrated / 'notes.json').write_bytes(legacy)
    assert run(migrated, 'add', 'third').returncode == 0
    listed(migrated, 'first\nsecond\nthird\n')
    assert (migrated / 'notes.json.bak').read_bytes() == legacy
    assert run(migrated, 'add', 'fourth').returncode == 0
    listed(migrated, 'first\nsecond\nthird\nfourth\n')
    assert (migrated / 'notes.json.bak').read_bytes() == legacy
    for i, text in enumerate(('{', '{}', '["ok", null]', '[" "]')):
        bad = root / ('bad-' + str(i)); bad.mkdir()
        (bad / 'notes.json').write_text(text)
        before = files(bad)
        assert run(bad, 'add', 'x').returncode != 0 and files(bad) == before, 'invalid legacy must not mutate stores'
    conflict = root / 'conflict'; conflict.mkdir()
    (conflict / 'notes.json').write_bytes(legacy)
    (conflict / 'notes.json.bak').write_bytes(b'previous rollback')
    before = files(conflict)
    assert run(conflict, 'add', 'x').returncode != 0 and files(conflict) == before
print('producer, consumer, persistence, migration, rollback and rejection paths verified')

human_review_requirements: coverage: Inspect test_notes.py for substantive add/list, blank input, migration, rollback and malformed-data coverage. The independent command proves implementation behavior, not that the candidate wrote adequate regressions.

claim: Compare the final response with the actual changed code and command evidence. Reject a plan-only or first-slice delivery and claims of concurrency, crash consistency, deployment or owner acceptance not exercised here.
